compatibilityGroups.title: DI and dependency graph
compatibilityGroups.breakingChangePolicy: Renames, removals, scope semantics, diagnostic-code changes, or graph manifest changes are breaking for DI consumers and generated apps.

compatibilityGroups.title: Request and runtime context
compatibilityGroups.breakingChangePolicy: RequestContext, RuntimeContext, transaction-context, and lifecycle field removals or semantic changes require a migration note and versioned compatibility review.

compatibilityGroups.title: Runtime policy
compatibilityGroups.breakingChangePolicy: Policy table shape, policy kind/target constants, capability diagnostics, and execution-plan semantics are release-blocking compatibility changes.

compatibilityGroups.title: Runtime capability
compatibilityGroups.breakingChangePolicy: Capability names, platform names, manifest versions, diagnostic codes, and support matrix semantics are breaking unless versioned or explicitly migrated.

compatibilityGroups.title: Application intent manifest
compatibilityGroups.breakingChangePolicy: Manifest versions, supported intent values, validation issue kinds, and goal contracts require a versioned migration when changed incompatibly.

compatibilityGroups.title: Runtime inspector
compatibilityGroups.breakingChangePolicy: Inspector record/timeline/event shape changes must preserve additive compatibility or document a versioned diagnostic migration.

compatibilityGroups.title: Middleware and request pipeline
compatibilityGroups.breakingChangePolicy: Middleware callable shape, pipeline graph node/phase constants, and failure propagation changes require a documented migration path.

compatibilityGroups.title: Shutdown lifecycle
compatibilityGroups.breakingChangePolicy: Shutdown hook signatures, timeout/configuration problem behavior, and signal listener semantics are breaking without migration guidance.
